title: server hotkeys
description: This thingy adds hotkeys that ops can set where if u right click with a set item in hand, it does a command
body:
HotkeyPlugin is a Minecraft plugin for Bukkit/Spigot servers that lets players assign custom commands to specific items as "hotkeys." Here's what it does:
Set Hotkeys: Operators (OPs) can use /hotkey set <item> <command> to bind a command to an item (e.g., /hotkey set DIAMOND_SWORD say Hello!). Only OPs can create or remove hotkeys to keep things secure.
Use Hotkeys: Any player can right-click with the assigned item in their main hand to execute the command instantly—no typing required!
Toggle On/Off: Players can enable or disable their hotkeys with /hotkey toggle to avoid accidental triggers.
List Hotkeys: Use /hotkey list to see all your assigned hotkeys.
Persistence: Hotkeys and toggle settings save automatically in a file and reload when the server restarts.
It's great for shortcuts like quick chat messages, gamemode switches, or teleport commands, making gameplay faster and more fun. Just drop the JAR into your server's plugins folder and restart!
